$comment: The three territories this register covers, kept deliberately APART. NYC+Westchester is the delivered dataset and keeps the original file paths at data/*.json — nothing about it moves, so nothing about it breaks. Each newer territory owns a directory beside it and is collected, validated and published on its own. They are never merged: coverage, opt-out rules and menu-platform mix all differ by region, and one blended figure would hide every difference. A territory names EITHER the counties it contains or the ones it excludes — upstate is defined by exclusion on purpose, so a county that issues its first licence tomorrow is covered instead of silently dropped by a list written today. A county name is only unique inside a state — Suffolk, Essex and Franklin are counties of both New York and Massachusetts — so every territory names its state, and membership is the state AND the county.

territories.label: New York City & Westchester
territories.note: The original scope. Its files stay at data/*.json — do not move them.

municipalOptOut.note: Checked one municipality at a time. No NYC borough opted out and Westchester is recorded in full, so the field is settled for this territory. It is also the reference the LOCAL-map adapter is measured against — see scripts/ingest/opt-out.ts --verify.

territories.label: Upstate New York
territories.note: Everything above Westchester to the Canadian border — defined as every county that is neither the original scope nor Long Island.

municipalOptOut.note: DELIBERATELY FROZEN, not forgotten. Roughly a third of upstate municipalities opted out of retail, and we have not established which. Every page built on this territory must render opt-out as 'not checked' — never as 'no ban'. Thawing it is one command: docs/FROZEN-municipal-opt-out.md.

territories.label: Long Island
territories.note: Suffolk and Nassau. Neither upstate nor in the original scope; kept separate so it is never silently folded into either.

municipalOptOut.note: DELIBERATELY FROZEN, not forgotten. Same rule as upstate: unknown renders as unknown. docs/FROZEN-municipal-opt-out.md.

territories.label: Massachusetts
territories.note: The first territory outside New York, run to measure what a second state costs. Imported from the Cannabis Control Commission's open data (scripts/ingest/ma-run.ts), not from OCM. See docs/MASSACHUSETTS.md.

municipalOptOut.note: DELIBERATELY FROZEN, same rule as upstate. Under G.L. c.94G §3 a Massachusetts city or town may prohibit or limit Marijuana Retailers by bylaw or ordinance, and many have. The Commission publishes a Municipal Zoning Tracker for all 351 municipalities, and says itself that it is not an official legal determination. Not collected: unknown renders as unknown.
